description: read_rss_mb is broken everywhere. Linux: the {% if flag?(:freebsd) %} branch is skipped so no /proc/self/status read happens at all; falls back to GC.stats.heap_size (Boehm committed heap, NOT resident set). FreeBSD: the branch parses Linux-style 'VmRSS:' from /proc/curproc/status, but FreeBSD procfs status has no such field, so the regex never matches and it also falls back. Consequences: PressureLevel thresholds (500/650/800) documented as 'RSS' are applied to GC heap size; heap_size also misses VmData growth (exactly what quickhea-alz investigates). Downstream consumers acting on the wrong number: memory_aware.cr (backpressure, fail-open to Low), monitoring.cr startup_rss_mb, refresh_supervisor, task_scheduler, app_state_service. Also: rescue fallback returns @last_rss_mb which is 0.0 before first success, masking read failures as Low pressure. Fix: read /proc/self/status VmRSS on Linux via flag?(:linux), use sysctl kern.proc or procstat on FreeBSD (or drop the bogus branch), return nil/raise on failure instead of 0.0, and document the metric per platform.
title: RSS never measured: metric is GC heap size on both platforms
